explication: Ponytail is an AI-agent guidance product: a user invokes an agent, the selected host adapter resolves a persistent intensity mode, injects the shared YAGNI-oriented ruleset, and routes specialized skills or subagent context. Session hooks and adapters share filesystem state and configuration, while MCP, Pi, Hermes, Cursor, and Claude-style integrations expose the same behavior through different host protocols. The graph preserves documented skill branches and status reporting; some host wiring is inferred only where sampled source explicitly shows it.
